summary: Design and monitor compliance programmes with ISO 37301, COSO, dashboards, and audit-ready reporting. Enrol to build practical tools.
lede: A compliance programme turns obligations, risks and policies into assigned controls, role-based learning, monitoring and reporting. This training is for professionals working with compliance, risk, audits, controls or learning who need to make those activities measurable. Participants practise mapping risks and control ownership, building role-based training matrices and monitoring dashboards, and organizing corrective actions and audit evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with policies, controls, audits, training, or risk reporting and now need a clearer system for compliance programme design and monitoring. It suits you if you own part of the workflow and need to turn fragmented compliance activity into a measurable operating model.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and if possible, a recent policy, audit finding, training report, or compliance dashboard from your work environment. Familiarity with internal control concepts, risk registers, or LMS reporting will help you move faster through the exercises, but the course includes guided templates for applied work.
